Subject: CAIQ / CSA CCM mapping & supporting evidence request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Greenfield Health is moving quickly on our evaluation. Our security team has asked for a completed CAIQ (CSA Cloud Controls Matrix) mapping and supporting evidence for a handful of controls: logging/monitoring (CCM-01/CCM-07), data encryption (CCM-09), network isolation and segmentation (CCM-08), and vendor management (CCM-05).

Can you provide:
- A filled CAIQ spreadsheet (CSV/Excel) mapping Redwood controls to the CCM IDs we listed (we can share the exact template if helpful)
- Evidence artifacts (redacted SOC 2 report, architecture diagram showing network segmentation, example log retention policy / sample logs)
- Expected turnaround (our procurement window is tight — ideally within a week)

If you prefer, please send a single zip with filenames clearly labeled (e.g., CAIQ_Mapping.xlsx, SOC2-2025.pdf, network-diagram.png). We may follow up with a short technical call.

Thanks,
Aisha Kumar
Director, Information Security
Greenfield Health

Team — forwarding Aisha’s request. Quick notes from legal/compliance on sharing:

- SOC2: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report with customer-identifying details redacted. Redact sample customer names and account IDs; keep control narratives intact.
- Network diagram: high-level segmentation diagram is fine; do not include internal IP ranges or hostnames.
- Logs: provide a sample of audit log metadata (timestamp, event type, resource id redacted) and point to the retention policy doc.
- CAIQ mapping: ensure mapping column indicates where the control is met (policy/procedure/technical), and a reference to the artifact file name.

Marcus — can you assemble the following artifacts into a folder and name them exactly as below? That makes it easier for me to run through quick redaction checks.
- Greenfield_CAIQ_Mapping_2026.xlsx (populated CAIQ)
- SOC2-Type2-2025-redacted.pdf (redacted)
- network-segmentation-2026.png (high-level)
- audit-log-sample.csv (metadata only)
- CAIQ_notes-onepage.pdf (control notes / mitigations)

Also, confirm any controls where we have partial coverage so we can call them out (e.g., third-party attestation cadence, encryption key custody for some managed services).

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
